d:
"Lemon Tree" is one of the biggest hits of the past 25 years. Now Alle Farben has reworked Fools Gardens classic in his typical soundscheme to give the song a new life which we all can enjoy.
A DOERING PRODUCTION
starring: Nicole De Livron
director: Jannis Döring
director of Photography: Bastian Kempf
producer: Kevin Ferstl
production assistant: Mats Bohle
drone operator: Alexander Charlet
